statement: Prime-Measure Scaling Limit and Half-Density TC Bridge Audit: For dilation scale h = tau^K (tau = 2*pi, K in Z), the prime-power jump measure mu = sum_{n >= 1} Lambda(n) delta_n transports under dilation d_h(x) = hx to the pushforward measure mu_h = (d_h)_* mu = sum_{n >= 1} Lambda(n) delta_{hn} with support {h * p^r : p prime, r >= 1}. Distinct integer grades have strictly disjoint prime supports (supp(mu_{tau^K}) cap supp(mu_{tau^J}) = empty set for K != J) by the transcendence of 2*pi (Lindemann 1882). Under dilation, Lebesgue measure transforms by (d_h)_* dx = h^{-1} dx, forcing the Jacobian-normalized measure nu_h = h * mu_h = h * sum_{n >= 1} Lambda(n) delta_{hn}. By the Prime Number Theorem (unconditional), nu_h converges weakly to Lebesgue measure dx as h -> 0+ (K -> -infty) on compactly supported smooth test functions in C_c^infty((0, infty)), with cumulative mass nu_h((0, X]) = h * psi(X/h) -> X. The canonically centered half-density fluctuation F_h = h^{-1/2} * (nu_h - dx) has cumulative form F_h((0, X]) = h^{1/2} * (psi(X/h) - X/h). In the explicit formula, a nontrivial zero rho = 1/2 + delta + i*gamma contributes with scale factor h^{-1/2} * h^{1 - rho} = h^{1/2 - rho} = tau^{-K*(delta + i*gamma)}, whose modulus is |h^{1/2 - rho}| = tau^{-K*delta}. For on-line zeros (delta = 0), the mode is a pure phase with unit modulus for all K; for off-line zeros (delta != 0), functional-equation symmetry guarantees a mode with delta > 0 that grows exponentially as tau^{-K*delta} in the fine-grade direction K -> -infty. In smoothed pairings <F_h, phi> = -sum_rho phi_tilde(rho) * h^{1/2 - rho}, finite zero models cannot cancel across all grades. However, while Jacobian normalization (H1) is forced by coordinate transport and centering (H2) is selected by the functional equation, grade regularity of {F_h} (H3: boundedness or precompactness) is NOT derived from TC covariance axioms. Imposing H3 as an exclusion criterion is mathematically equivalent to assuming RH: Transcendental Continuation does not force half-density regularity independently of the Riemann Hypothesis.

hypotheses: mu = sum_{n >= 1} Lambda(n) delta_n is the prime-power jump measure on (0, infty)
d_h(x) = hx is the coordinate dilation by h = tau^K
nu_h = h * mu_h is the Jacobian-normalized prime measure

Functional equation symmetry pairs zero displacement delta with -delta
object_studied: Transported prime measure mu_h, Jacobian-normalized measure nu_h, weak PNT limit dx, half-density fluctuation F_h, and smoothed explicit formula zero sum
fourier_normalization: Additive Fourier-Laplace transform on R; Mellin transform phi_tilde(s) = int_0^infty phi(x) x^{s-1} dx on R_+
multiplicity_convention: Nontrivial zero multiplicity m_rho >= 1 and discrete grade indexing K, J in Z
measure_and_window: Pushforward discrete prime measure mu_h; Lebesgue continuum measure dx on R_+; test functions in C_c^infty((0, infty))
order_of_limits: Fine-grade limit h = tau^K -> 0+ (K -> -infty); cumulative limit X/h -> infty
exact_conclusion: The Jacobian-normalized prime measures have the common weak limit dx by the prime number theorem, despite their separated discrete supports. Half-density normalization exposes the factor h^{-delta - i*gamma}, but TC covariance alone does not require the resulting fluctuation family to be bounded or convergent. The remaining regularity condition (H3) is not derived independently of RH.
logical_negation: Jacobian normalization nu_h fails to converge to dx under PNT, or prime supports intersect across distinct integer grades, or TC covariance forces boundedness of {F_h} without assuming RH (FALSIFIED / REFUTED)
falsification_attempts: Gate 1 & 4 (Symbolic Elimination & Equality-Case Audit): proved that prime-power collision tau^K * p1^r1 = tau^J * p2^r2 requires tau^{K-J} = p2^r2 / p1^r1 in Q, impossible for K != J by Lindemann (1882), establishing exact support disjointness; exact algebraic identities (1 - s) - 1/2 = 1/2 - s and (1/2) - (1/2 + delta) = -delta formalized in Lean 4

Gate 2 & 5 (Boundary Dominance & Jacobian Normalization): proved that coordinate dilation d_h(x) = hx contracts Lebesgue measure by (d_h)_* dx = h^{-1} dx, forcing unique linear scaling nu_h = h * mu_h to compare with external density dx; verified boundary limit K -> -infty gives nu_h((0, X]) = h * psi(X/h) -> X by PNT

Gate 3 & 9 (Weak Limit & Smoothing): tested pairing <nu_h, phi> on compactly supported smooth bump test functions phi in C_c^infty((0, infty)); demonstrated weak convergence error decaying below 0.003 at K = -3 without any off-line zero defect

Gate 6 & 7 (Zero Mode Scaling, Off-Diagonal Audit & Modulus Tracking): tracked exact mode scaling h^{1/2 - rho} = tau^{-K*(delta + i*gamma)}; in smoothed pairing <F_h, phi>, off-diagonal cross-terms and phase interference between distinct zero modes m != n do not eliminate exponential growth tau^{-K*delta} as K -> -infty for delta > 0, while unit modulus holds identically for delta = 0

Gate 8 (Non-Circularity Audit & TC Content): separated H1 (Jacobian h, forced by geometry), H2 (center 1/2, selected by functional equation), and H3 (regularity/boundedness of {F_h}); audited that TC covariance imposes no bound on {F_h}, proving that asserting H3 is mathematically equivalent to assuming RH
Gate 10 (Dual Status Classification): passed all 10 structural schema gates and established formal verification under Mathlib foundational axioms
